national_rules.nationalAllocation: One nationwide constituency; seats shared among lists by the highest-quotient system (Art. 5, Art. 129).

description.en: A list below 3% of the voters who voted takes no part in the seat allocation (Art. 128); national-minority lists are exempt (Art. 140).
description.zh-CN: 得票低于投票选民人数 3% 的名单不参与席位分配（第 128 条）；少数民族名单不受此限（第 140 条）。

minorityRepresentation.en: National-minority lists take part even below 3%; their quotients are then increased by 35% (Art. 140). Which lists had this status is decided by the commission and is not stored here.
minorityRepresentation.zh-CN: 少数民族名单即使低于 3% 也参与分配，此时其商数提高 35%（第 140 条）。哪些名单具有这一地位由选举委员会决定，此处不存储。

totalSeatsDefinition.en: 250 seats, all filled from electoral lists in one nationwide constituency.
totalSeatsDefinition.zh-CN: 250 席，全部由一个全国选区的选举名单产生。

notes.en: List proportional representation with 250 seats in one nationwide constituency. Votes and seats are printed in the commission’s total-results report. The 2020 statute version was not read: the seats reproduce under the 2026 rule (3% threshold, 35% minority quotient increase), recorded as a consistency check only. List labels: full titles usually name persons and are not stored.
notes.zh-CN: 比例代表制，一个全国选区共 250 席。得票与席位来自选举委员会总结果报告。未阅读 2020 年版法律：席位可按 2026 年规则（3% 门槛、少数民族商数提高 35%）复现，仅作一致性核对。名单标签：完整名称通常含人名，不予存储。
